Coast, parks and islands

Latina Lido, coastal lakes and dunes form a distinctive protected landscape. Sabaudia, San Felice Circeo and Terracina are nearby seaside destinations. Explore Ninfa Garden, the Pontine Islands and Circeo National Park, as well as Sermoneta, Cori, Norma, Terracina, Gaeta and Fondi.
